summary: mdlearn is a machine learning toolbox specifically designed for molecular dynamics data processing. It provides utilities for preprocessing MD-derived inputs such as coordinates, contact maps, and RMSD, and implements PyTorch-based representation-learning models. Supported models include Quasi-Anharmonic Analysis (QAA), Convolutional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE), Autoencoder (AE), and Adversarial Autoencoder (AAE). The package offers training, inference, visualization, and latent-space analysis, with GPU-accelerated options. mdlearn focuses on transforming MD data into ML-ready features and learning latent embeddings, but does not perform force-field calculations, general trajectory analysis, or kinetic estimations. It overlaps significantly with SAWNERGY's concept of contact-map-based convolutional autoencoding, though SAWNERGY adds time-resolved physics-based,predictive,biological-validation,features.
title: mdlearn
